hints.title: Two-Phase Strategy
hints.text: Phase 1: Explore and map the labyrinth using depth-first search with backtracking. Phase 2: Compute shortest path to target using breadth-first search.

hints.title: Recursive Backtracking Traversal
hints.text: When moving in direction D with master.move(D), record the coordinate and always move back with opposite direction after exploring subtrees.

hints.title: BFS Shortest Path on Discovered Graph
hints.text: Run BFS starting from (0, 0) over the set of visited floor cells to find the minimum distance to the target coordinate.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Explores every accessible cell in 4 directions with backtracking, then executes BFS across the mapped graph.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting BFS directly requires arbitrary robot teleportation which is disallowed by GridMaster.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DFS maps physical cell layout, unlocking unweighted shortest path computation via BFS.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: DFS exploration with physical backtracking followed by BFS on the reconstructed grid.
